old.name: Toton Sidings
old.what: Europe's largest marshalling yard at the height of the coal traffic, sorting Nottinghamshire coal. In decline by the 1970s: the north yard closed in 1978 and the up side in 1984, and it was cut back to its present shape in the late 1980s.

old.name: Stanton Ironworks
old.what: Ironworks from 1846 by the Nutbrook Canal, about 7,000 workers at its height under British Steel, later Stanton and Staveley and Saint-Gobain. The last pipe was cast on 24 May 2007. The 470-acre site is now proposed for housing.
